purpose: Machine-readable OmniContext loading order for arbiter (Claude Code first; the other assistant shims are installed and route to the same .ai/ source of truth).

requirement_access.policy: Never read .ai/requirements/requirements.json or requirements-archive.json in full and never hand-edit them; query and change them through the CLI, which allocates ids across both files so a retired id is never reused.
requirement_access.archive: python omni requirement archive (sweeps completed beyond --keep-recent and every withdrawn entry) or --id REQ-### once the outcome is recorded in CHANGELOG.md and .ai/project-context.md; archived entries stay queryable with show, search and list --all.

failure_access.policy: Before editing a file run `python omni graph why <path>`; when a defect or failed check is fixed, record it with `python omni failure add` and update it with `python omni failure update` (root cause, regression test, prevention rule). `requirement complete` refuses a defect requirement without an entry.
read: python omni graph why <path or symbol>

completion_gate.purpose: Executes the co_changed validations in the completion rulepack against the git change set. training/ and .arbiter/ (the nightly measurement job's output) are exempt in the rulepack; waive anything else explicitly with python omni waive <rule-id> --reason "...". Enforced three ways: the git hooks (python omni hook install-git --with-graph-rebuild; each clone opts in with git config core.hooksPath .githooks), the Claude Code Stop hook (python omni hook install), and the pull-request workflow, which runs python omni doctor and python omni gate.

mcp_servers.arbiter: arbiter mcp (src/arbiter/mcp.py): arbiter_scan, arbiter_gate, arbiter_review_queue; see docs/mcp.md
mcp_servers.omni: python omni mcp serve (omni_mcp.py): read-only graph, requirement, failure and gate tools
mcp_servers.note: python omni doctor starts both servers for real and fails if either cannot answer initialize and tools/list.

any_session: Read .ai/project-configuration.md, .ai/project-map.md, and the active requirement (python omni requirement show <ID>).
Read only the rulepack, playbook or checklist relevant to the active task.

Allocate ids with `python omni requirement add` or `draft`; complete with `python omni requirement complete`; sweep terminal entries out with `python omni requirement archive` once their outcome is recorded in CHANGELOG.md and .ai/project-context.md.
Update CHANGELOG.md when behavior, probes, adapters, packs, gates or scoring change; reference the REQ-### the change serves. python omni gate checks that the change set carries it.
Run python omni graph why <path> before editing, and record fixed defects in the failure ledger.
Use .ai/.ignore to exclude sensitive or irrelevant paths.

See .ai/project-context.md.
